name: Family Apart
beschreibung: Family Apart is a hotel complex in Fulpmes, a village in the Stubaital in Tirol. The location offers access to extensive hiking trails in the surrounding mountains and to the ski area Stubaier Gletscher. The apartments have a kitchenette and separate sleeping areas, making them suitable for self-catering. The atmosphere is relaxed and geared toward the needs of families. Families with children in particular, as well as couples who value independence, are likely to feel comfortable here.
